nodes.name: 2026-05-23-waggle-os-ux-design.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive UX design specification for Waggle OS covering 13 sections including spatial chrome/window choreography, the omnibar command surface, multi-agent visibility, memory-as-fabric patterns, workspace scenes, trust/approval choreography, and a phased rollout plan across 3 phases. Establishes the north-star UX vision and interaction model for the desktop AI agent platform.

nodes.name: 2026-06-01-hermes-compact-on-stop-design.md
nodes.summary: Design specification for OQ-4 — an opportunistic, time-gated compact-on-Stop feature for the Hermes Agent hook package, detailing the stateless constraint, the new compact-on-stop.ts module, composition into stop.ts, TDD test plan, and rollback criteria. Covers the save-first ordering in the Stop hook and success gates.
nodes.languageNotes: Spec references TypeScript module `compact-on-stop.ts` composed into `src/hooks/stop.ts` within the hive-mind-hooks-hermes package.

nodes.name: 2026-06-01-openclaw-dedup-design.md
nodes.summary: Design specification for OQ-6 — provenance-insensitive save-side deduplication to prevent double-capture in the OpenClaw gateway hook, including the mechanism, decision log, the change required, properties, testing approach, and risks. Targets the hive-mind-hooks-openclaw package.

nodes.name: 2026-06-01-wave23-hook-feasibility-research.md
nodes.summary: Feasibility research document assessing the portability of the hive-mind claude-code hook package to 6 other AI tools (Cursor, Codex CLI, Codex Desktop, Hermes, OpenClaw, Claude Desktop), classifying each into 4 implementation tiers (near-direct port, lifecycle-hooks-need-adapter, mcp-bridge-only, not-feasible-now) with per-tool details, recommended implementation order, key risks, and OSS-mirror implications.

nodes.name: 2026-06-01-wave23-hook-stubs-design.md
nodes.summary: Full design specification for Wave 2/3 hive-mind hook ports covering the shared @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-core package architecture (EventAdapter interface, install-core.ts, handlers-core.ts, json-register.ts, CliBridge composition), per-package designs for all 5 Tier A/B packages (codex, codex-desktop, cursor, hermes, openclaw), lifecycle-to-tool-event mapping, cross-cutting concerns, testing strategy, and build order. The most detailed artifact governing the Wave 2/3 AI-OS hook expansion.
nodes.languageNotes: Specifies TypeScript interfaces (EventAdapter) and module boundaries across 6 new npm workspace packages; references YAML config format for Hermes and JSON5 for OpenClaw as hook registration mechanisms.

nodes.name: 2026-06-09-temporal-substrate-fix-design.md
nodes.summary: Concise design spec for fixing temporal reasoning deficiencies in the hive-mind-core memory substrate, proposing a two-phase additive approach: Phase 1 surfaces snippet timestamps and prompt guidance at zero LLM cost, Phase 2 optionally adds dated distilled facts. Includes root cause analysis, success/regression gate criteria, OSS hygiene notes, and explicit YAGNI out-of-scope items.
nodes.languageNotes: References hive-mind-core as the shared renderer location for the temporal surface change; tied to the LoCoMo benchmark temporal gap (-9pp vs Memori).
